page.title: Automations
page.description: Schedules start agents at set times, triggers start them when something happens.

schedules.empty: No schedules yet. E.g. a report every morning at 9 or a check every hour.
schedules.deleteDescription: "{name}" will stop running. Past runs stay in the history.

scheduleDialog.description: The agent gets the prompt as a message and runs at the set time.
scheduleDialog.cronInvalid: The expression needs 5 fields: minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week.
scheduleDialog.promptPlaceholder: E.g. Summarize the tasks finished yesterday and send it to me on Telegram.

cron.everyNHours: {n, plural, one {Every hour at minute {min}} other {Every # hours at minute {min}}}

triggers.empty: No triggers yet. E.g. a webhook from your online store that asks the agent to process every new order.
triggers.deleteDescriptionWebhook: "{name}" and its webhook URL will stop working.

eventHints.webhook: An external system sends a POST request
eventHints.emailReceived: Your email provider forwards each email

triggerDialog.description: An external or internal event starts an agent run.
triggerDialog.webhookHint: After saving you get a unique webhook URL.
triggerDialog.webhookHintKeep: After saving you get a unique webhook URL (the existing token is kept).
triggerDialog.rateLimitHint: Over this many in a minute, the webhook answers 429 and starts no run. Empty uses {count}.
triggerDialog.promptPlaceholder:
E.g. A new order came in. Check it and create a delivery task.

{payload}

payloadHelp.webhook: {payload} becomes the POST request body (formatted JSON or text).
payloadHelp.emailReceived: {payload} becomes what the email provider sends (sender, subject, content).
payloadHelp.taskCreated: {payload} becomes the JSON of the created task (id, title, status, output).
payloadHelp.taskDone: {payload} becomes the JSON of the finished task (id, title, status, output).

triggerDialog.payloadAppended: If the prompt does not contain {payload}, the data is appended at the end.
triggerDialog.projectFilter: With a project selected, it only fires for that project's tasks. Without one, it fires for tasks outside projects and for those of projects whose team the agent is on.

webhook.title: Webhook: {name}
webhook.descriptionEmail: Set up your email provider (e.g. inbound parse) to POST every received email to this URL.
webhook.description: Any external system can start the agent by sending a POST to this URL.
webhook.urlHint: The URL contains a secret token: anyone who has it can start runs. The request body (max 1 MB) becomes {payload} in the prompt; valid JSON is formatted automatically.
webhook.urlHintSigned: The URL contains a secret token, but it is not enough on its own: only requests signed with the signing secret start runs. The request body (max 1 MB) becomes {payload} in the prompt; valid JSON is formatted automatically.
webhook.response: Response: {example}. It returns 401 when a required signature is missing or wrong, 429 after {limit} requests in a minute (wait as long as Retry-After says) and 503 while the kill switch is on.
webhook.regenerateDescription: The old URL will stop working. You will need to update the systems that use it.

signing.title: Request signing
signing.off: Optional. With a signing secret, only requests signed with it start runs; the URL alone is no longer enough.
signing.on: On. Requests without a valid signature are refused with 401.
signing.enableDescription: From now on, requests without a valid signature are refused. The secret is shown only once: add it to the sender right away.
signing.rotateDescription: The current secret stops working at once. Requests signed with it are refused until the sender uses the new one.
signing.removeDescription: The secret is deleted and the URL alone is enough to start runs again.
signing.secretOnce: Copy it now: it is not shown again. If you lose it, rotate it.
signing.standardWebhooks: Standard Webhooks: give the secret as it is to the sender's Standard Webhooks library. It sends webhook-id, webhook-timestamp and webhook-signature; requests older than {minutes} minutes and repeated ids are refused.
signing.github: GitHub: paste the secret into the webhook's Secret field. GitHub signs each request in X-Hub-Signature-256.

webhook.noToken: This trigger has no token. Save it with a webhook event.

errors.triggerNotWebhook: The trigger does not use a webhook
errors.agentNotOnTeam: The agent is no longer on the project's team, so the automation did not run
errors.previousStillWorking: The previous run of this schedule is still being worked on. Try again once it is done.
